title: Image requests follow supported shapes and prompt settings
summary:
A day spent tuning image generation: steadier queues, clearer prompt behavior, and less blocking work behind the scenes.

Requested image dimensions now map to the closest supported aspect ratio, and short prompts respect an explicit `enhance=false` setting. Tests were added across generation, processing, caching, prompts and queues.

Queue counts now come from Flux workers, and queueing events reach feed listeners again. Worker tracking was extended across Flux, Turbo and translation services, with routing fixes to keep requests in the right pool. Flux also retains more generation steps under moderate load.

Image operations switched to asynchronous file I/O, and the cache gained a 500,000-entry limit. Debug logs and progress tracking replace much of the previous console output. Prompt sanitization now strips non-ASCII characters before sending text to the image backend, changing how accented prompts are handled.
